name: text-generate-effect

frames.best_why: Frame 6 is the only one where every word is sharp; the others leave a blurred tail on the sentence.

tagline: A bold sentence sharpens into focus one word at a time.
summary: Takes a sentence and splits it into words that fade in from a blur one after another, so the line assembles itself on load. It plays once and settles as plain bold text.
appearance: A single bold white sentence across a black stage, set in two centred lines. In early frames the tail of the sentence is soft and blurred while the opening words are already crisp.
behaviour: On mount the words reveal left to right, each one lifting from blurred and transparent to sharp white with a short stagger, until the whole line is legible. It runs once and never repeats.
demo_content: The sentence "Build beautiful animated interfaces with ease using Aceternity UI components."
search_phrases: text that fades in from blur
use_when: A short statement should draw the eye as it assembles the first time it is seen.
avoid_when: The copy is critical and must be readable at once, or it sits far below the fold.
customise: words is the sentence; className, filter and duration control styling, whether words blur, and length. The 0.2s stagger and 10px blur are fixed in the source.
weight_why: One sentence split into spans that animate a single time.

a11y.note: The blur-in reveal runs even under reduced-motion; the text is plain and readable once it finishes.

issues: The reveal only fires once on mount, so anyone arriving after it finishes sees plain text.
Words still blurred at the start are unreadable for a moment.
polish_why: A clean, well-timed word reveal, but it is visually just a bold sentence with one trick.
